purpose: Create the visual evidence layer for the complete Outdoor curriculum. Every asset must help a learner observe, measure, compare, diagnose, or make a bounded field decision; decorative filler and genetics/strain-card imagery are prohibited.

designSystem.brandRule: THC — Teaching Healthy Cultivation only. Do not use DTFSeeds or DTF Genetics as the infographic brand.
designSystem.masterCanvas: 8.5 x 11 in portrait, 2550 x 3300 px, 300 DPI
designSystem.style: academic studio-quality cannabis cultivation education; detailed realistic plant and field imagery; clean cream/green scientific layout; natural color; crisp labels; no yellow cast; no cartoon/vector-card look
designSystem.textPolicy: Scientific but plain-language. Use concise labels, legends, measurement callouts and differential notes instead of dense paragraph blocks.
designSystem.diagnosticPolicy: Never equate one visible symptom with one cause. Comparison plates must show look-alikes and the next evidence to collect.
designSystem.measurementPolicy: Show units, sensor/observation position and repeat method when the visual teaches measurement. No unsupported universal thresholds.
designSystem.accessibilityPolicy: Each asset requires descriptive alt text, a learner-facing caption, readable contrast and information that does not rely on color alone.

chapters.title: Sex Expression, Pollen Drift & Seed-Set Investigation

legacyQueueContext.rule: Legacy THC-OUT-01 through THC-OUT-11 may be superseded or expanded by V2 assets. Do not mark a V2 diagnostic/measurement gap complete merely because a broad legacy poster has a similar title.
